title: ENFORCEMENT RULES OF THE ACT ON THE SUPPORT FOR CULTURAL AND ARTISTIC ACTIVITIES OF ARTISTS WITH DISABILITIES

ENFORCEMENT RULES OF THE ACT ON THE SUPPORT FOR CULTURAL AND ARTISTIC ACTIVITIES OF ARTISTS WITH DISABILITIES

Article 1 (Purpose): These Rules prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Support for Cultural and Artistic Activities of Artists with Disabilities and its Enforcement Decree, and matters necessary for their implementation.

Article 2 (Procedure for Supporting Costs for Improving Cultural Facilities)

(1) A person seeking support for expenses necessary to improve the accessibility of cultural facilities for artists with disabilities under Article 12(2) of the Act on the Support for Cultural and Artistic Activities of Artists with Disabilities (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") and Article 6(2) of its Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as the "Decree"), hereinafter referred to as "cultural facility improvement expenses", shall, pursuant to Article 6(2) of the Decree, submit an application for support in attached Form No. 1 to the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism or the head of a local government, with the following documents:
1. Current status of the cultural facility to be improved
2. Improvement plan
3. Budget

(2) After receiving the support application form as described in (1), the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism or the head of a local government shall, considering the validity of the improvement plan and budget, decide whether to provide financial support for improving cultural facilities and notify the applicant of the decision.

Article 3 (Procedure for Designating a Dedicated Institution)
① An institution seeking to be designated as a dedicated institution under Article 14(1) of the Act shall, pursuant to Article 7(2) of the Decree, submit an application for designation in attached Form No. 2, to the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism, along with the following documents:
1. Articles of Association
2. Business plan
3. Documents proving compliance with the requirements specified in each item of Article 7(1) of the Decree
② Upon receiving the application for designation under paragraph (1), the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism shall verify the certificate of registered corporate particulars in accordance with Article 36(1) of the Electronic Government Act through the shared use of administrative information.
③ The designation certificate for the dedicated institution, as issued by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism in accordance with Article 7(3) of the Decree, shall be in attached Form No. 3.

ADDENDUM <Ministerial Ordinance No. 422, December 14, 2020>
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.
